state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports that longer training increases win rate: debater Elo scores imply the SFT-only model wins 31% of rounds against other checkpoints and the fully DPO-trained model 67%. For consultancy, the judge votes for the SFT model 36% of the time and for the fully trained DPO model 50% of the time, which the authors suspect reflects the judge's skepticism toward SFT outputs.
title: DPO training raises debater win rate from 31% (SFT) to 67%; consultant from 36% to 50%
